correctness.rationale: All-positive/all-negative trace test gives the forest/connectivity lemma, with constructive extension for every labeling. Acyclicity reduces to at most two distinct double-column pairs; complement connectivity is exactly the zero-column/two-singleton-label criterion. Counting is by d=0,1,2 double columns and exactly subtracts disconnected configurations, including n-d=0. Explicit constructions attain min(n+2,2n-2). Rank-maximum witness pairs violate exchange for every n>=3. Independent exhaustive trace calculation for all 37448 supports across n=1..5 supports the all-parameter proof.
